raw_sections.personal_information:
Suraj Kumar
Phone: 7081506940
Email : rjsuraj541@gmail.com 
Contact Management, Sales Pipeline, Campaign Management, Customer Support, and Notification Services.
Implemented API Gateway with Circuit Breaker patterns and fallback mechanisms to ensure high availability.
Managed synchronous REST communications between CRM services and asynchronous event streaming using Kafka for lead updates, campaign triggers, and support ticket events. - Built a workflow/state machine for automated lead-to-customer lifecycle transitions (Lead → Qualified → Opportunity → Customer).
Implemented Redis caching for frequently accessed CRM data such as leads, customer profiles, and campaign metadata.
Utilized AWS S3 for storing customer documents, campaign assets, and attachments; MongoDB for flexible customer activity logs; MySQL for core transactional CRM records.
Developed Angular-based dashboards, lead forms, sales pipeline views, customer profiles, and support ticket screens with real-time updates via event streaming.
Marketplace (LOCCA)
Tech Stack: Spring Boot, JWT, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes
Developed backend microservices for Product Management, Seller Management, Customer Management, Order Processing, Payments, and Real-Time Deals. - Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control for Admin, Seller, and Customer user types.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for product listing, inventory updates, order placement, order tracking, and payment workflows.
Built asynchronous workflows using message queues (e.g., Kafka) for order events, payment confirmations, and inventory updates.
Implemented caching strategies (Redis) for frequently accessed data such as product details, price information, and seller performance stats.
Ensured performance optimization, centralized logging, monitoring, and containerized deployment with Kubernetes, enabling seamless scaling and high availability.
